title: ever AYLANI|Sparkling V-Neck Floral Cold-Shoulder Evening Dress with Pleated
descriptionHtml:
This dazzling A-line evening dress has a V-neck and ruched details, designed in a glittering fabric. The off-shoulder look is beautifully complemented by floral decorations on the shoulders.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
